intent.goal: Give an accurate, useful overview of recent issues and activity trends.
intent.acceptance: Partial native factual facet: the listed objects are independent surviving Issue identities whose creation timestamps fall in the exact report-declared seven-day interval and whose independent retained transfer timelines contain zero events. Also preserve independently provable missing opening events when that transfer-free surviving creation lower bound exceeds the claimed total.

profile.authoring: Outcome-informed retrospective: source and candidate prose exposed before this explicit native-facet contract. Latest surviving marker-discovered report selected, not a representative or blind sample.

originalCensusProposal.goal: Give an accurate, useful overview of recent issues and activity trends.
originalCensusProposal.population: Issues opened in the last seven days and declared 30-day chart activity facts.
originalCensusProposal.acceptance: Independent event reconstruction and reader-question checks establish correct statistics, complete scope and supported interpretations.
originalCensusProposal.evidencePlan: Freeze event/window definitions and independent factual/interpretive questions before assessing summaries.
originalCensusProposal.missingReason: No independent summary-usefulness/interpretation instrument or accepted historical summaries collected.

grounding.quote: Analyze all issues opened in the repository ${{ github.repository }} over the last 7 days.

originalCensusProposal.limitation: Issue or chart counts describe inputs/outputs, not the attained quality of the summary.

profile.historicalCompatibility: Only the retained run-head profile is evaluated; earlier periods are unmeasured.
profile.baseline: Actual source addition verified against its real parent, not first output or shallow boundary. No comparable outcome baseline reconstructed.

evidence.opportunity: Every distinct issue URL in the report's explicitly bounded 'Human issues opened this week' list, plus a separately reported lower-bound total-opening contradiction check.
filters: Latest surviving pre-cutoff Discussion with this exact workflow marker in the already fully acquired inventory. One selected report per workflow; all other reports remain unassessed. No random, representative, blind or complete-lifetime claim.
Only this retained run-head source era; current worker assignment requirements are not backdated.
evidence.collection: Offline deterministic original-byte verification and native oracle; no model, Git, network, target execution, or current body/state backdating.

model.architecture: Source-specific bounded factual accuracy, separately retaining full goal and unknowns.
model.recommendation: Not rated: no agreed native keep bar or matched costs.

metrics.name: Listed new-issue window accuracy
metrics.formula: 100 * independently accepted / independently assessed facts in this one explicitly bounded native facet; not full report accuracy

metrics.name: Assessment coverage of eligible facet facts
metrics.formula: 100 * independently assessed / eligible literal native facts; no eligible facts is null

metrics.name: Independently verified native facts
metrics.formula: accepted independent native facts, not reports or generated items

metrics.name: Proven minimum omitted issue creations
metrics.formula: surviving independently observed creations exceeding the claimed total; 0 means no proven lower-bound violation, not exact correctness

safeguards.fullGoal: Independent event reconstruction and reader-question checks establish correct statistics, complete scope and supported interpretations.
safeguards.fullAcceptance: Unmeasured; bounded native facets do not replace the original census acceptance.
safeguards.attribution: Editable discovery footer corroborated with run identity/path/head; not an authoritative creation receipt.
safeguards.limitations: No full historical creation ledger is claimed. Missing/deleted/transferred identities are unknown, not invalid. Human identity, authors, titles, labels, states, complete issue-list coverage, charts and interpretations remain unmeasured. A zero undercount floor is not proof of correctness.
